'''Dumerin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagrian]] [[Major/Legends|major]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. During the [[Battle of Ilum]] in [[3640 BBY]] he asked a Republic citizen to destroy [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] turrets and the [[Maintenance droid/Legends|maintenance droids]] repairing them.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Major Dumerin appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as an NPC on Ilum and begins the mission "Icy Destruction."
